extraction.notes: Whole decision read (pages 1-9). The decision approves the Reform Agendas of five partners; only recital (15) concerns North Macedonia specifically, and only its reference to the digital transition is extracted (theme_doubtful). Other recitals and articles are procedural or financial (facility amounts, pre-financing, WBIF channelling, approval of the Reform Agendas) or concern other partners, and make no Chapter 2 or technology claim. No Chapter 2 material. Period covered not given in the register or the document; left empty. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.

items.stated_text: It will address structural changes and undertake reforms required to modernize the economy, especially by boosting green and digital transition, modernising the labour market, the business environment, and in parallel with reforms that will foster good governance and enforce the fundamentals of enlargement.
items.summary: The Commission states that North Macedonia's Reform Agenda will modernise the economy, notably by boosting the green and digital transition.
items.extraction_note: Commission conclusion on the North Macedonia Reform Agenda in recital (15). The digital transition is one aim in a list of broad aims; kept as theme_doubtful because the claim is general and may be incidental under the materiality test.

pass2.classification_note: Materiality test not met: digital transition is one aim in a list of broad aims of the Reform Agenda
